cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Physics / Experimental 启用 `ChaosVehiclesPlugin`（运行时 `ChaosVehicles`，编辑器 `ChaosVehiclesEditor`）并重启。
新建继承 `AWheeledVehiclePawn` 的 Pawn（或从插件示例复制），给根加上 `UChaosWheeledVehicleMovementComponent`，不要再用旧 PhysX `UWheeledVehicleMovementComponent`。
为每个轮胎创建 `ChaosVehicleWheel` 类：半径、悬架刚度/阻尼、转向角、驱动/手刹标志；在 Movement 的 `Wheel Setups` 里把骨骼名绑到这些轮子。
在同一组件上填 `Engine Setup`、`Transmission Setup`、`Steering Setup` 和 `Differential`（扭矩、换挡、差速），并确认骨骼网格体已开 Chaos 物理资产。
用 Enhanced Input 把油门/刹车/转向/手刹接到 `Set Throttle Input` / `Set Brake Input` / `Set Steering Input` / `Set Handbrake Input`。
关卡放 Blocking Volume 当地面，打开 `Chaos Vehicles` 相关 Show Flag 或 Visual Logger，PIE 里检查轮胎接触与侧滑。
游戏模块 `Build.cs` 只依赖 `ChaosVehicles`；`ChaosVehiclesEditor` 仅放 *Editor 目标。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `ChaosVehiclesPlugin` in `Edit > Plugins` (runtime `ChaosVehicles`, editor `ChaosVehiclesEditor`) and restart.
Create a pawn based on `AWheeledVehiclePawn` (or copy the plugin sample) and add `UChaosWheeledVehicleMovementComponent`; do not use the old PhysX `UWheeledVehicleMovementComponent`.
Author a `ChaosVehicleWheel` class per tire (radius, spring/damper, steer angle, driven/handbrake flags) and bind bone names in Movement `Wheel Setups`.
Fill `Engine Setup`, `Transmission Setup`, `Steering Setup`, and `Differential` on that component, and make sure the skeletal mesh has a Chaos physics asset.
Wire Enhanced Input throttle/brake/steer/handbrake to `Set Throttle Input` / `Set Brake Input` / `Set Steering Input` / `Set Handbrake Input`.
Give the map collision ground, enable Chaos Vehicles debug / Visual Logger, and PIE to check tire contact and slip.
Game `Build.cs` depends on `ChaosVehicles` only; keep `ChaosVehiclesEditor` on an Editor target.
note_cn: 实验性 Chaos 载具，不是破碎/字段插件，也不是 PhysX Vehicles。接口可能随夜构建变化。
note_en: Experimental Chaos vehicles — not fracture/fields, and not PhysX Vehicles. The contract can change on nightlies.

cn_steps: 启用 MetaHuman 插件 `Character Creation Tools`（`CharacterEditState`、`CharacterEditTools`、`CharacterEditInteractiveTools`、`CharacterMeshConformer`、`CharacterEditToolsEditor`）。
打开或新建 MetaHuman `Character` 资产，进入角色编辑器视口；本插件提供共享编辑状态与 Interactive Tools Framework 外壳，不是单独的动画采样节点。
用视口里的交互工具刷体型、头部或服装参数；工具会话状态走 `CharacterEditState`，不要自己往 Actor 上挂同名组件当玩法。
需要把服装/配件贴合身体时走 `CharacterMeshConformer`：选目标骨骼网格与源网格，执行 conform，检查绑定与法线。
改完后从角色编辑器导出/更新骨骼网格与 Control Rig，再放到关卡或 Sequencer 里看绑定，而不是在 AnimBP 里“采样 Character Creation Tools 资产”。
`CharacterEditToolsEditor` 只留在 Editor Target；运行时数字人播放依赖 MetaHuman 运行时绑定，不要把编辑工具链进 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable the MetaHuman plugin `Character Creation Tools` (`CharacterEditState`, `CharacterEditTools`, `CharacterEditInteractiveTools`, `CharacterMeshConformer`, `CharacterEditToolsEditor`).
Open or create a MetaHuman `Character` asset and enter the character editor viewport. This plugin is the shared edit-state and Interactive Tools Framework shell, not an AnimBP sampler.
Sculpt body/head/wardrobe with the viewport interactive tools; session state lives in `CharacterEditState`. Do not treat those types as gameplay components on a pawn.
Fit clothing or accessories with `CharacterMeshConformer`: pick target skeletal mesh and source mesh, run conform, then check skinning and normals.
Export/update the skeletal mesh and Control Rig from the character editor, then place that mesh in a level or Sequencer. Do not “sample a Character Creation Tools asset” on an animation track.
Keep `CharacterEditToolsEditor` on an Editor target. Runtime MetaHuman playback uses the runtime binding stack, not these authoring tools.
note_cn: 给 MetaHuman 角色编辑器的共享工具壳，不是运行时角色控制器。
note_en: Shared authoring shell for the MetaHuman character editor, not a runtime character controller.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `CharacterAI`（模块 `CharacterAI`）并重启；内容来自 `Engine/Plugins/Experimental/CharacterAI`。
准备带 `CharacterMovement` 的 `Character` 与 `AIController`，关卡生成 NavMesh Bounds，这是角色向 AI 的基座，不是通用 EQS 浏览器。
在插件 Content 里找 CharacterAI 相关资产/组件（移动、朝向、角色感知辅助），挂到 NPC 上，而不是搜索一个叫 `CharacterAI` 的空子系统当玩法入口。
用行为树或插件提供的任务/服务驱动该角色：巡逻点、对玩家的朝向与移动请求走 Character 移动接口，避免直接 `SetActorLocation`。
PIE 打开 AI Debug (`'` / `AI` show flags) 看路径与焦点；确认走的是 `CharacterAI` 逻辑而不是默认 `MoveTo` 模板。
游戏模块可依赖 `CharacterAI`；实验接口可能改名，不要当 Shipping 硬依赖。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `CharacterAI` (module `CharacterAI`) and restart. Content lives under `Engine/Plugins/Experimental/CharacterAI`.
Use a `Character` with `CharacterMovement` plus an `AIController`, and build NavMesh. This plugin targets character-based AI, not a generic EQS browser.

Attach the plugin’s CharacterAI assets/components (locomotion, facing, character-centric sensing helpers) to the NPC. There is no empty “CharacterAI subsystem” gameplay entry you just search in Details.
Drive the pawn from Behavior Tree or the plugin’s tasks/services so patrols and player facing go through Character movement, not `SetActorLocation`.
In PIE, use AI Debug (`'` / AI show flags) and confirm the pawn is following `CharacterAI` logic rather than a stock `MoveTo` template.
Game modules may depend on `CharacterAI`; treat the API as experimental and avoid a hard Shipping contract.
note_cn: 实验性角色向 AI 代码/资产包，不是 Behavior Tree 编辑器本身。
note_en: Experimental character-oriented AI code and assets, not the Behavior Tree editor.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental Toolset 插件 `CheatsToolset`（模块 `CheatsToolset`）。这是给编辑器 AI 助手/自动化列作弊命令用的，不是关卡里的 Cheat 组件。
在 PlayerController 上指定 `Cheat Class`（自定义 `UCheatManager` 子类），用 `UFUNCTION(exec)` 写出 `God`、`Fly` 一类命令。
PIE 进入游戏，确保本地 Player 已拥有带 CheatManager 的 Controller（非 Shipping、允许 cheats）。
通过编辑器 Toolset / 助手调用本插件：先列出本地玩家 CheatManager 上的命令，再按名调用并传参数。
对照控制台 `~` 手动敲同一条 exec，确认 Toolset 调到的是同一 `UCheatManager` 实例。
不要把 `CheatsToolset` 写进 Game Target 或包装；Shipping 应关闭作弊通道。
en_steps: Enable Experimental Toolset plugin `CheatsToolset` (module `CheatsToolset`). It lists/invokes cheats for the in-editor assistant or automation, not a level component.
Set the PlayerController `Cheat Class` to your `UCheatManager` subclass and expose commands with `UFUNCTION(exec)` (`God`, `Fly`, …).
PIE so the local player owns a Controller with that CheatManager (cheats allowed, not Shipping).
From the editor Toolset / assistant, list commands on the local player’s CheatManager, then invoke by name with arguments.
Cross-check by typing the same exec in the `~` console; both paths must hit the same `UCheatManager` instance.
Do not link `CheatsToolset` into a Game target or packaged build; disable cheats for Shipping.
note_cn: 编辑器 Toolset，面向助手自动化；不是给玩家做内置修改器菜单。
note_en: Editor toolset for assistant automation, not an in-game mod menu.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chooser`（运行时 `Chooser` / `ProxyTable`，编辑器 `ChooserEditor` / `ProxyTableEditor`；未烹饪模块 `ChooserUncooked` / `ProxyTableUncooked` 不要进 Game Target）。
内容浏览器右键 `Animation > Chooser Table`，添加上下文列（Bool / Enum / Float / 对象）和结果列（动画序列、Pose Search 数据库或其他 UObject）。
填行：每行是一组条件 → 选出的资产；用编辑器里的调试/评分查看当前上下文命中哪一行。
需要按角色换表时再新建 `Proxy Table`：键是逻辑名，值指向不同 Chooser 或资产，把角色差异从 AnimBP 里抽出去。
在动画蓝图 AnimGraph 加 `Evaluate Chooser`（或 Chooser Player）节点，把移动速度、状态枚举等接到上下文引脚，输出接到 `Output Pose`。
PIE 用 AnimBP 调试叠层看每次选中的行；烹饪后只保留 `Chooser` 与 `ProxyTable` 运行时数据。
en_steps: Enable `Chooser` (runtime `Chooser` / `ProxyTable`, editors `ChooserEditor` / `ProxyTableEditor`). Keep `ChooserUncooked` / `ProxyTableUncooked` off Game targets.
Content Browser → `Animation > Chooser Table`. Add context columns (Bool / Enum / Float / object) and a result column (AnimSequence, Pose Search database, or other UObject).
Author rows as condition sets → chosen asset; use the table debugger/scoring to see which row the current context hits.
For per-character remaps, create a `Proxy Table` (logical names → different Choosers/assets) so AnimBP stays character-agnostic.
In the AnimGraph add `Evaluate Chooser` (or Chooser Player), wire speed/state enums into context pins, and feed the pose to `Output Pose`.
PIE with the AnimBP debugger to confirm the selected row. Cooked games keep only runtime `Chooser` / `ProxyTable` data.
note_cn: 动态选资产表，不是把 Chooser 资产拖到骨骼网格上采样的组件。
note_en: Data-driven asset selection tables, not a component you drop on a skeletal mesh.

cn_steps: 启用运行时插件 `Chunk Downloader`（模块 `ChunkDownloader`），游戏 `Build.cs` 加入该模块。
在 `Project Settings > Packaging` 打开 `Generate Chunks`，给要流式下发的资产指定 `Chunk ID`（Pakchunk），打出带清单的 Pak。
把清单与 Pak 放到 HTTP(S) 分发根目录；在启动代码里 `FChunkDownloader::Get()`，`Initialize(PlatformName, TargetDownloadsInFlight)`，再 `LoadCachedBuild` / `UpdateBuild(DeploymentName, ContentBuildId)`。
用 `GetLoadingProgress` 更新 UI，下载完成后 `MountChunk` / 挂载 Pak，再 `LoadPackage` 或切关卡。
在 `DefaultGame.ini` 的 `[ChunkDownloader]` 段配置缓存目录、部署名与可选 BaseUrl；这不是 Online Subsystem 登录凭证。
用弱网和断点续传各测一遍；Shipping 包只含启动块，其余走本客户端拉取。
en_steps: Enable runtime `Chunk Downloader` (module `ChunkDownloader`) and add it to the game `Build.cs`.
Turn on `Generate Chunks` under `Project Settings > Packaging`, assign `Chunk ID`s to streamed assets, and cook Paks plus a manifest.

Host the manifest and Paks on HTTP(S). At startup `FChunkDownloader::Get()`, `Initialize(PlatformName, TargetDownloadsInFlight)`, then `LoadCachedBuild` / `UpdateBuild(DeploymentName, ContentBuildId)`.
Drive UI from `GetLoadingProgress`; after download `MountChunk` / mount Paks, then `LoadPackage` or open the map.
Configure cache path, deployment name, and optional BaseUrl under `[ChunkDownloader]` in `DefaultGame.ini`. This is not Online Subsystem login.
Test slow networks and resume. Shipping should ship the bootstrap chunk only; the rest streams through this client.
note_cn: 流式安装/分块下载客户端，不是 Online Subsystem 实现。
note_en: Streaming-install / chunk client, not an Online Subsystem implementation.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `CineCameraRigs`（`CineCameraRigs` + `CineCameraRigsEditor`）。
在关卡放置 `CineCameraRigRail`：编辑样条作为轨道，把 `CineCameraActor` 附加到轨道挂点，用 `Absolute Position on Rail`（0–1）滑车。
需要摇臂时放置 `CineCameraRigCrane`，调臂长、Yaw/Pitch，把同一台电影机挂到 crane mount。
打开该镜头的 Level Sequence，给 Rail/Crane 加 Transform 或专用轨道关键帧（沿轨位置、摇臂角），不要只关键帧摄像机世界坐标。
视口切到该 `CineCameraActor` 看片，核对焦距/胶片门与轨道运动是否一致。
`CineCameraRigsEditor` 仅编辑器定制；运行时序列播放只依赖 `CineCameraRigs`。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `CineCameraRigs` (`CineCameraRigs` + `CineCameraRigsEditor`).
Place a `CineCameraRigRail`, edit its spline, attach a `CineCameraActor` to the rail mount, and drive `Absolute Position on Rail` (0–1).
For a jib, place `CineCameraRigCrane`, set arm length and yaw/pitch, and attach the same cine camera to the crane mount.
In the shot’s Level Sequence, key the rail/crane tracks (position on rail, crane angles) instead of only the camera’s world transform.
Look through that `CineCameraActor` and check focal length / filmback against the rig motion.
`CineCameraRigsEditor` is editor customization only; sequence playback needs runtime `CineCameraRigs`.
note_cn: 电影机轨道/摇臂装置，不是 nDisplay 同步插件。
note_en: Cine-camera rail and crane rigs, not an nDisplay sync plugin.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `CineCameraSceneCapture`（模块 `CineCameraSceneCapture`）。
内容浏览器新建 `TextureRenderTarget2D`（尺寸对齐镜头输出），放到材质或 UMG Image 上预览。
在已有 `CineCameraActor` 上添加电影机场景捕捉组件（插件提供，行为对齐 `SceneCaptureComponent2D`，但走电影机镜头/胶片门/对焦）。
把 RT 赋给该组件的 Texture Target，设置 Capture Every Frame 或按需 `Capture Scene`，Primitive Render Mode 按需要 Include/Exclude 演员。
对比同一台 `CineCameraActor` 的视口取景与 RT：裁切、景深、胶片门应一致；不要用普通 `SceneCapture2D` 冒充电影机成像。
PIE 或 LED/监看材质上查看 RT；实验接口可能调整，正式流水线先小场景验证。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `CineCameraSceneCapture` (module `CineCameraSceneCapture`).
Create a `TextureRenderTarget2D` sized to the shot and preview it on a material or UMG Image.
Add the plugin’s cine-camera scene-capture component to an existing `CineCameraActor`. It mirrors `SceneCaptureComponent2D` but uses cine lens, filmback, and focus.
Assign the RT as Texture Target, capture every frame or call `Capture Scene`, and Include/Exclude primitives as needed.
Compare the `CineCameraActor` viewfinder to the RT: crop, DOF, and filmback should match. A plain `SceneCapture2D` will not.
View the RT in PIE or on a monitor surface. Prove it on a small scene; the experimental API can still move.
note_cn: 把电影机视图画进 RT，不是再造一套 Scene Capture 摄像机。
note_en: Renders a cine-camera view into an RT; it is not a second Scene Capture camera type.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cinematic Assembly Tools (CAT)`（`CineAssemblyTools`、`CineAssemblyToolsEditor`）。
内容浏览器创建 Cine Assembly / CAT 资产，作为镜头集合（线性成片），而不是单条 Level Sequence。
把已有 `Level Sequence` 镜头登记进 Assembly：镜头号、场景、Take、绑定的关卡与摄像机。
用 CAT 编辑器浏览/排序镜头、切换当前 Shot、从 Assembly 打开对应 Sequencer，做线性内容的镜头管理。
需要整段回放时从 Assembly 播放或导出镜头列表，而不是在 nDisplay 面板里找 CAT。
`CineAssemblyToolsEditor` 只进 Editor；游戏里若只播单条 Sequence，不必依赖 CAT。
en_steps: Enable `Cinematic Assembly Tools (CAT)` (`CineAssemblyTools`, `CineAssemblyToolsEditor`).
Create a Cine Assembly / CAT asset in the Content Browser — a shot collection for linear editorial, not a single Level Sequence.
Register existing `Level Sequence` shots on the assembly (shot code, scene, take, map, camera).
Use the CAT editor to sort shots, switch the current shot, and open the matching Sequencer for linear shot management.
Play or export the assembly as a shot list. Do not look for CAT inside the nDisplay panel.
Keep `CineAssemblyToolsEditor` on Editor targets. Gameplay that only plays one sequence does not need CAT.
note_cn: 镜头装配/成片管理套件，不是摄像机追踪或 LED 墙驱动。
note_en: Shot-assembly / editorial suite, not camera tracking or LED-wall drive.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cinematic Prestreaming`（运行时 `CinematicPrestreaming`，编辑器 `CinematicPrestreamingEditor`）。
打开过场 `Level Sequence`，确保镜头会触发虚拟纹理、Nanite 或纹理流送（远切近、大场景）。
用插件的录制流程（Sequencer / Movie Render 相关入口）在过场中记录流送请求，生成 `Cinematic Prestreaming` 数据资产。
回到时间轴，为该 Sequence 加上 Prestreaming 轨道，把资产挂上，并让请求比摄像机到达提前若干帧/秒。
PIE 或 MRQ 回放同一镜头，对比未挂轨道时的贴图/几何弹出；预流是提前排队 IO，不是后期处理开关。
游戏模块只链 `CinematicPrestreaming`；录制 UI 留在 Editor。
en_steps: Enable `Cinematic Prestreaming` (runtime `CinematicPrestreaming`, editor `CinematicPrestreamingEditor`).
Open the cinematic `Level Sequence` and make sure the camera move will hitch virtual textures, Nanite, or texture streaming (hard cuts, large worlds).
Run the plugin’s record path (Sequencer / Movie Render related) during the cutscene to capture streaming requests into a Cinematic Prestreaming asset.
Add a Prestreaming track on the sequence, assign that asset, and offset so requests fire seconds/frames before the camera arrives.
PIE or MRQ the same shot and compare pop-in with the track disabled. This queues IO early; it is not a post-process toggle.
Link only `CinematicPrestreaming` in game modules; keep recording UI on Editor.
note_cn: 给过场预热流送请求，不是 Show Flag 也不是后期体积选项。
note_en: Warms streaming requests for cinematics; not a show flag or post-process volume setting.

cn_steps: 先启用 `Cinematic Assembly Tools (CAT)`，再启用 Experimental `Cinematic Sequence Navigator Bridge`（模块 `CinematicSequenceNavigator`）。
打开 CAT Assembly，确认其中已登记若干 `Level Sequence` 镜头。
打开 `Sequence Navigator`（电影装配用的镜头导航器），本桥把它接到 CAT Assembly，而不是普通动画资产。
在 Navigator 里点镜头名应跳到 Assembly 中对应 Shot 并打开 Sequencer；不要把桥资产挂到骨骼网格。
增删 Assembly 镜头后刷新 Navigator，确认列表与当前 Shot 同步。
这是编辑器导航桥，不要写入 Game `Build.cs` 或 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable `Cinematic Assembly Tools (CAT)` first, then Experimental `Cinematic Sequence Navigator Bridge` (module `CinematicSequenceNavigator`).
Open a CAT assembly that already lists several `Level Sequence` shots.
Open `Sequence Navigator`; this bridge binds it to cinematic assemblies, not to generic animation assets.
Clicking a shot in the Navigator should select that assembly shot and open Sequencer. Do not attach the bridge to a skeletal mesh.
Add/remove assembly shots and refresh the Navigator to confirm the list and current shot stay in sync.
Editor navigation only — do not add it to a Game `Build.cs` or Shipping build.
note_cn: CAT 镜头列表与 Sequence Navigator 之间的桥，本身不做动画采样。
note_en: Bridge between CAT shot lists and Sequence Navigator; it does not sample animation.

cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Programming 启用 `CLion Integration`（模块 `CLionSourceCodeAccess`）并重启。
打开 `Edit > Editor Preferences > General > Source Code`，把 `Source Code Editor` 设为 `CLion`。
本机安装 CLion，并对当前 `.uproject` / 引擎源码执行 Generate Project Files（CMake）。
内容浏览器双击 C++ 类，或 `Tools > Open CLion` / Open Source Code；应由 `CLionSourceCodeAccess` 把文件交给 CLion，而不是 Visual Studio。
从 Class Viewer 或蓝图 Goto C++ Definition 再验证跳转。不要把该模块写进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `CLion Integration` under `Edit > Plugins` (Programming); it loads `CLionSourceCodeAccess`, then restart.
Open `Edit > Editor Preferences > General > Source Code` and set `Source Code Editor` to `CLion`.
Install CLion locally and generate project files (CMake) for this `.uproject` / engine tree.
Double-click a C++ class in the Content Browser, or use `Tools > Open CLion` / Open Source Code; `CLionSourceCodeAccess` should hand the file to CLion, not Visual Studio.
Confirm Goto C++ Definition from Class Viewer or a Blueprint also lands in CLion. Do not link this module into a Game target.
note_cn: 编辑器源码访问器，不进 Shipping。
note_en: Editor-only source accessor; do not ship it.

cn_steps: 启用 `Cloners and Effectors`（`ClonerEffector`、`ClonerEffectorMeshBuilder`、编辑器 `ClonerEffectorEditor`），并确保 Niagara 已开。
在放置 Actor 列表里放 `Cloner` Actor，选 Layout（Grid / Circle / Line / Spline / Mesh 等），指定要克隆的静态或骨骼网格。
再放置 `Effector` Actor，让其范围覆盖克隆实例；选噪声、吸引、平面等效应，调强度与衰减，观察实例变换/颜色被逐个推动。
需要碰撞网格时走 `ClonerEffectorMeshBuilder` 生成合并网格，而不是在 Niagara 编辑器里新建一个空白 System 当入口。
把 Cloner/Effector 加进 Sequencer，关键帧效应器位置或强度，做虚拟制片运动图形。
游戏运行时只依赖 `ClonerEffector`（及需要的 MeshBuilder）；编辑器模块勿进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `Cloners and Effectors` (`ClonerEffector`, `ClonerEffectorMeshBuilder`, editor `ClonerEffectorEditor`) and make sure Niagara is on.
Place a `Cloner` actor, pick a layout (Grid / Circle / Line / Spline / Mesh, …), and assign the static or skeletal mesh to instance.
Place `Effector` actors so their volume covers clones; choose noise/attractor/plane etc., tune strength/falloff, and watch per-instance transform/color.
Use `ClonerEffectorMeshBuilder` when you need a built collision/render mesh. Do not start from a blank Niagara System as the entry point.
Add cloner/effectors to Sequencer and key effector transforms or strength for VP motion-graphics shots.
Runtime depends on `ClonerEffector` (and MeshBuilder if needed); keep the editor module off Game targets.
note_cn: 关卡里的 Niagara 克隆器/效应器 Actor，不是 Niagara 模块栈里的普通发射器模板。
note_en: Level-placed Niagara cloner/effector actors, not a generic Niagara emitter template.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental `Code Editor`（模块 `CodeEditor`）并重启；这是编辑器内嵌代码编辑，不是游戏组件。
从 `Window` / `Tools` 打开 `Code Editor` 面板（或从 C++ 类资产“在编辑器中打开”）。
在面板中打开项目 `.h` / `.cpp`，修改后保存到磁盘；不要指望它替代 Rider/VS 的调试与 IntelliSense。
保存后用 Live Coding 或编译按钮验证；语法错误仍走虚幻编译日志。
不要把 `CodeEditor` 写进 Game `Build.cs` 或 Shipping。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Code Editor` (module `CodeEditor`) and restart. It edits source inside Unreal, not as a gameplay component.
Open the `Code Editor` panel from `Window` / `Tools` (or “open in editor” on a C++ class asset).
Load project `.h` / `.cpp` files, edit, and save to disk. It does not replace Rider/VS debugging or IntelliSense.
After save, Live Coding or compile and watch the Unreal build log for errors.
Do not add `CodeEditor` to a Game `Build.cs` or Shipping target.
note_cn: 实验性编辑器内代码编辑，接口可能变化；不能当正式 IDE。
note_en: Experimental in-editor code editing; not a production IDE, API may change.

cn_steps: 启用测试插件 `Code Quality Tests Unreal Test Plugin`（描述符 `CQTest.uplugin`，模块 `CQTestTests`）。它测的是引擎 `CQTest` 框架，不是给游戏加组件。
打开 `Tools > Session Frontend` → `Automation`，筛选 `CQTest` / `CQTestTests`。
跑这组用例，确认断言、期望宏与测试夹具在编辑器自动化会话里通过。
命令行也可用 `UnrealEditor-Cmd` 的 `Automation RunTests` 指向 `CQTest` 过滤器，便于 CI。
不要把 `CQTestTests` 链进游戏模块或 Shipping 包。
en_steps: Enable `Code Quality Tests Unreal Test Plugin` (`CQTest.uplugin`, module `CQTestTests`). It tests the engine `CQTest` module; it is not a gameplay component.
Open `Tools > Session Frontend` → `Automation` and filter `CQTest` / `CQTestTests`.
Run the suite and confirm asserts, expect macros, and fixtures pass in the editor automation session.
For CI, invoke `UnrealEditor-Cmd` `Automation RunTests` with a `CQTest` filter.
Do not link `CQTestTests` into a game module or Shipping package.
note_cn: CQTest 框架的自测插件，不是质量门禁配置工具。
note_en: Self-tests for the CQTest framework, not a quality-gate settings UI.
